chunks: ʿAmr ibn Shimr narrated from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
When the disk disappears, the fasting person breaks the fast, and the time of salat (prayer) begins.

key_terms.غَابَ: disappeared or went out of sight

ai.seo_question: When does it become permissible to break the fast and when does the time of salat (prayer) begin?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the sun’s disk disappears, the fasting person may break the fast and the time for salat (prayer) enters. It establishes a legal ruling concerning both the end of the fasting day and the beginning of the evening prayer time.
